$comment: Registry of privacy canaries (docs/data-inventory.md §8, E14-01 case 2, REQ-005). canary-page.html places every value where a careless sensor would pick it up; scripts/privacy-scan.mjs asserts none of them appears in storage.session, storage.local or the export preview. Values are unique literals, not secrets. Keep this file and canary-page.html in sync: the scan verifies the page reported each value as used.

canaries.where: location.search of the fixture URL (also pushState)
DOM text, localStorage value, string passed to new URL()
function name on the call stack of getImageData
S08: random-looking left label of a page request host (network/dns-pattern.html random mode, first label; canary-page.html URL string only, no DNS)
S08: port of a loopback image request of canary-page.html (http://127.0.0.1:45127/, refused locally); with the colon so random hex ids cannot match by chance

S06: navigator.userAgent of the canary context (scripts/privacy-scan.mjs launches it with launchPersistentContext userAgent = this value); canary-page.html also reads screen.* (sizes are numbers, not canaries)

$protectComment: ADR-020 «Защита» (S05): canaries of the opt-in module, kept apart from `canaries` because canary-page.html (observation scan) does not plant them. Typed into module fields by tests/extension/protect/password-never-read.spec.ts (all of them must be absent from storage.local, storage.session, the IndexedDB dump and the intercepted protect-* messages) and, from S15, by fixtures/privacy/protect-canary-page.html with their variants (md5/sha1/sha256/sha512 hex and base64, url, base64). The request-* values belong to the data-request generator (S14): they live only in the memory of requests.html.

protect.where: S05: typed into an e-mail field (type=email) of a page with the module on
S05: typed into a phone field (type=tel)
S05: typed into a name field (autocomplete=name)
S05: typed into a password field (autocomplete=current-password), also after «show password» turned it into type=text; never read by any layer
S14: identity entered on requests.html (memory of the page only)
S14: name entered on requests.html (memory of the page only)
